settlement.note: v22: Bitcoin-style ~10 min cadence. settle unlocks at most 1 block per call (MAX_SETTLE_BLOCKS=1) after advance_slots even when batch_trades==0. No bulk multi-block catch-up. auto_pay_trader uses u128 intermediate.

lpProgrammeAccrual.reason: The finalized, unpaused V9 LP programme may receive accrued BTEN. The keeper cannot withdraw, swap, add liquidity, fund farms, or access any capability.

nativeFarmSync.reason: Permissionless deterministic sync only moves the fixed staking allocation for blocks released after the farm started. The keeper receives no farm admin capability and cannot withdraw principal or rewards.

privilegedExecutors.reason: Requires a separately audited delegated KeeperCap upgrade; the GitHub keeper never receives RegistryAdminCap, UpgradeCap, farm caps, LP positions, or sponsor keys.

gatedMeans: Bitcoin-style one block per settle after 600s slots; trades/attestations accrue rewards but are not required to settle
